newsitem.title: USA: Station Casinos set to open new hotel/casino.
newsitem.headline: Station Casinos set to open new hotel/casino.

text.p: Station Casinos Inc will open its fourth gaming property in the Las Vegas area, the $198 million Sunset Station Hotel & Casino tonight at 2400 EDT/2100 PDT.
Station focuses on local residents as its primary market in Las Vegas and Sunset Station is designed to reach residents of the Henderson/Green Valley suburbs sourth of the city.

Sunset Station has 80,000 square-feet of casino space, over 2,700 slot and video poker machines, 41 gaming tables and a show room. Its hotel has 450 rooms, 12 restaurants, an arcade and 13 movie screens, Station said in a statement.

"Sunset Station retains many characteristics that have become our trademark, a well-defined theme, great service and great value," said Glenn Christenson, chief financial officer. "Architecturally, we have created a comfort and elegance that raises off-Strip standards."

Sunset Station has a Spanish/Mediterranean theme. Its centerpiece is the Gaudi Bar, which has over 24,000 pounds of stained glass forming its ceiling. The ceiling is patterned after the designs of Antoni Gaudi, one of Spain's most-renowned architects who was a leader of the art nouveau revolution of the late 19th century, Station said.
